Electrical_monitor.label: Electrical monitor
Electrical_monitor.description: The uCIFI electrical monitor object provides attributes related to the analysis of electrical consumption in an outdoor luminaire or in a streetlight cabinet. It also identifies electrical anomalies.

Supply_voltage.label: Supply voltage
Supply_voltage.description: Electrical voltage supplied to the device.

Supply_current.label: Supply current
Supply_current.description: Electrical current supplied to the device.

Frequency.label: Frequency
Frequency.description: Frequency of the supply current to the device.

Active_power.label: Active power
Active_power.description: Active power consumed by the device and its electrical load.

Power_factor.label: Power factor
Power_factor.description: Power factor is equal to active power divided by apparent power. The value is between -1 and  1.

Cumulated_active_energy.label: Cumulated active energy
Cumulated_active_energy.description: Cumulated number of Wh measured by the device and its load since last energy counter reset.

Low_power_factor_threshold.label: Low power factor threshold
Low_power_factor_threshold.description: Threshold below which the device should trigger a low power factor event.

Low_power_factor.label: Low power factor
Low_power_factor.description: Set to True if the power factor is below threshold. This is an absolute value threshold.

Low_power_threshold.label: Low power threshold
Low_power_threshold.description: Threshold below which the device should trigger a low power event.

Low_power_threshold_at_low_dim_level.label: Low power threshold at low dim level
Low_power_threshold_at_low_dim_level.description: Threshold below which the device should trigger a low power event. This is an addition to the low power threshold to allow a separated threshold when dim level is low.

Low_power.label: Low power
Low_power.description: Set to True if the power is below threshold. Vendor may consider the Low power threshold at low dim level to set this resource to True, taking into account the lamp dim level.

High_power_threshold.label: High power threshold
High_power_threshold.description: Threshold above which the device should trigger a high power event.

High_power_threshold_at_low_dim_level.label: High power threshold at low dim level
High_power_threshold_at_low_dim_level.description: Threshold above which the device should trigger a high power event. This is an addition to the high power threshold to allow a separated threshold when dim level is low.

High_power.label: High power
High_power.description: Set to True if the power is above threshold. Vendor may consider the High power threshold at low dim level to set this resource to True, taking into account the lamp dim level.

Low_current_threshold.label: Low current threshold
Low_current_threshold.description: Threshold below which the device should trigger a low current event.

Low_current.label: Low current
Low_current.description: Set to True if the current is below threshold.

High_current_threshold.label: High current threshold
High_current_threshold.description: Threshold above which the device should trigger a high current event.

High_current.label: High current
High_current.description: Set to True if the current is above threshold.

Low_voltage_threshold.label: Low voltage threshold
Low_voltage_threshold.description: Threshold below which the device should trigger a low voltage event.

Low_voltage.label: Low voltage
Low_voltage.description: Set to True if the voltage is below threshold.

High_voltage_threshold.label: High voltage threshold
High_voltage_threshold.description: Threshold above which the device should trigger a high voltage event.

High_voltage.label: High voltage
High_voltage.description: Set to True if the voltage is above threshold.

Critical_inrush_threshold.label: Critical inrush threshold
Critical_inrush_threshold.description: Threshold above which the device should trigger a critical inrush event.

Critical_inrush_current.label: Critical inrush current
Critical_inrush_current.description: Set to True if the inrush current is above threshold.

Minimum_inrush_Current.label: Minimum inrush Current
Minimum_inrush_Current.description: Minimum inrush current since last configuration.

Maximum_inrush_Current.label: Maximum inrush Current
Maximum_inrush_Current.description: Maximum inrush current since last configuration.

Latest_inrush_Current.label: Latest inrush Current
Latest_inrush_Current.description: Latest inrush current measured since last time the relay switched ON.

Reactive_power.label: Reactive power
Reactive_power.description: Instantaneous reactive power measured by the device and its electrical load.

Reactive_energy.label: Reactive energy
Reactive_energy.description: Cumulative reactive power measured by the device and its electrical load since last energy counter reset.

Low_power_threshold_at_custom_dim_level.label: Low power threshold at custom dim level
Low_power_threshold_at_custom_dim_level.description: If the measured power when the dimming is between "Custom dim level min range" and "Custom dim level max range" is below this threshold, a low power alarm is set.

High_power_threshold_at_custom_dim_level.label: High power threshold at custom dim level
High_power_threshold_at_custom_dim_level.description: If the measured power when the dimming is between "Custom dim level min range" and "Custom dim level max range" is above this threshold, a high power alarm is set.

Custom_dim_level_min_range.label: Custom dim level min range
Custom_dim_level_min_range.description: Custom dimming range (lower bound) to allow specification of finer grain thresholds and alarms.

Custom_dim_level_max_range.label: Custom dim level max range
Custom_dim_level_max_range.description: Custom dimming range (upper bound) to allow specification of finer grain thresholds and alarms.

Dimming_level.label: Dimming level
Dimming_level.description: Dimming level associated to current measurement.

Timestamp.label: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the measurement was performed.

Fractional_Timestamp.label: Fractional Timestamp
Fractional_Timestamp.description: Fractional part of the timestamp when sub-second precision is used (e.g., 0.23 for 230 ms).

Measurement_Quality_Indicator.label: Measurement Quality Indicator
Measurement_Quality_Indicator.description: Measurement quality indicator reported by a smart sensor. 0: UNCHECKED No quality checks were done because they do not exist or can not be applied. 1: REJECTED WITH CERTAINTY The measured value is invalid. 2: REJECTED WITH PROBABILITY The measured value is likely invalid. 3: ACCEPTED BUT SUSPICIOUS The measured value is likely OK. 4: ACCEPTED The measured value is OK. 5-15: Reserved for future extensions. 16-23: Vendor specific measurement quality.

Measurement_Quality_Level.label: Measurement Quality Level
Measurement_Quality_Level.description: Measurement quality level reported by a smart sensor. Quality level 100 means that the measurement has fully passed quality check algorithms. Smaller quality levels mean that quality has decreased and the measurement has only partially passed quality check algorithms. The smaller the quality level, the more caution should be used by the application when using the measurement. When the quality level is 0 it means that the measurement should certainly be rejected.

Energy_reset.label: Energy reset
Energy_reset.description: Reset both cumulated active and reactive energy counter.
